# Church Companion

> A Hindi-English digital church library and worship companion for the CNI congregation — song books, daily worship sets, the liturgical almanac and church history.

Church Companion is an offline-first web app. Members read the church song book
and additional songs in Hindi with English titles, follow the day's worship set,
check the liturgical almanac (theme, colour and readings), and browse the
church's story and timeline.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Today's worship songs, announcements and quick links to the library.
- [Song Book](/books/song-book): Choose between the Church Song Book and Additional Songs.
- [Church Song Book](/books/song-book/church): Numbered Hindi hymns used in regular worship.
- [Additional Songs](/books/song-book/additional): Extra worship songs beyond the main hymnal.
- [Almanac](/almanac): Daily liturgical theme, colour, and morning and evening readings.
- [About](/about): About the church, its ministries and its history.
- [Church](/about/church): Articles about the congregation and its life.
- [Timeline](/about/timeline): Dated articles and photos from the church's history.
- [Search](/search): Full-text search across songs and book sections.

## Optional

- [Bookmarks](/bookmarks): Saved songs and sections on this device.
- [Settings](/settings): Language, appearance, notifications and offline downloads.
